events.text: Saudi Arabia launches an airstrike at a market in Al Hazm, Al-Jawf Governorate, Yemen, killing 14 civilians and wounding ten more.

events.topic: 2026 Iran war fuel crisis, Canada and the 2026 Iran war
events.text: The Bank of Canada raises its policy interest rate by 25 basis points to 2.5%, its first increase since July 2023, citing persistent inflation driven partly by higher oil and gasoline prices linked to the Iran war.

Jio Platforms raises US$3.2 billion in India's largest-ever initial public offering (IPO), attracting about $77 billion in bids and becoming the country's most-subscribed IPO before its stock-market debut in Mumbai.
At least three people are killed as Cyclone Arnab makes landfall in Andhra Pradesh, India.
At least 68 people are killed and 179 injured during a collision between two high speed trains carrying over 500 passengers between Los Yébenes and Urda, in the Province of Toledo, Spain.

events.topic: Rwanda–United States relations, Democratic Republic of the Congo–Rwanda conflict
events.text: The United States imposes sanctions on the Rwandan ministry of defence over its role in the conflict in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, alleging that Rwanda is backing the M23 rebels to fight against Congolese forces.
A youth armed with two knives wounds a police officer outside the Israeli embassy in Belgrade, Serbia, before being shot and killed.
British far-right activist Tommy Robinson is convicted of harassing two journalists and causing them to fear violence.
The ruling Likud and its governing coalition, led by Benjamin Netanyahu, wins a plurality of seats in the Knesset, though government formation remains unclear.

events.topic: Aftermath of the 2026 Brazilian general election
events.text: Brazilian senator Flávio Bolsonaro, following his flee from Brazil and arrival in Florida, United States, after the general election, declares himself the rightful president-elect of Brazil.

events.topic: Aftermath of the 2026 Brazilian general election
events.text: Brazilian president Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva responds by accusing the U.S. government of colluding with Bolsonaro to install him as president.
In baseball, the Fukuoka SoftBank Hawks defeat the Yokohama DeNA BayStars in four games to win its 13th Japan Series championship.
